notes: New Footage page: search your videos by describing what you're looking for - 'a person at the front door', 'white van', 'dog on the lawn'. Add your footage folders and press 'Index now' (or let it index automatically while the PC is idle); each video is looked at once by an AI model on the graphics card. Results show the best moment of each video with a picture; double-click to watch from that moment, right-click for 'Find more like this moment' or to send videos to another page.

Footage: a calendar shows the days with footage and how much was recorded each hour (from the recording time in the file names, or the file date). Click a day or an hour to list its videos or to search only then.
Footage settings: pictures whenever the picture changes or at a fixed interval, normal or fine detail (finds small things), index on request or automatically when the PC is idle, hide weak matches.
Settings > Your PC: 'Subject Tracker speed test' - times finding subjects and reframing on a made-up 4K clip, each way Breezy can do it, so you can see what your PC is fastest at.
Tasks: finished tasks stay in the list after Breezy restarts (for example after an update), until you click 'Clear finished'.
